summary: A while loop repeats as long as its condition is True. Use it when you do not know ahead of time how many times to repeat.
notes: The condition is checked before each pass through the loop.
savings = savings + 30 changes the value the condition checks.
When the condition is False at the start, the body runs zero times.
pitfall: Forgetting to change the variable in the condition makes an infinite loop. The program never stops. Press Ctrl+C to stop it.
